# Page Shell Pattern

Use this pattern when a page needs a stable top structure and consistent framing.

## Includes

- title
- subtitle
- primary action area
- optional secondary actions
- content stack with consistent section spacing

## Why It Matters

- This is where generic-template feel often starts.
- Stable page shell rules improve hierarchy, spacing rhythm, and page-level usability.

## Default Shape

- top header row
- descriptive title block
- actions aligned to the working area
- content sections below with consistent spacing

## Asset

- `assets/patterns/PageShell.tsx`
